faq.label: Questions
faq.title: Questions, answered.
items: How long until the store is delivered?
Foundation and Growth usually take 5–7 business days from the day we have your products and content. Growth Partner needs a deeper plan on the discovery call.
Do I need to code to run the store?
No. You get a clear dashboard and recorded videos for orders, new products, and edits.
What does the AED 50,000 Growth Partner package include?
A strategic partnership: infrastructure from scratch, identity, and high-budget campaigns. We work as your dedicated tech and marketing team.
Do you run ads on their own?
Yes, for clients with product-market fit and at least $5,000 in monthly ad spend. Book a call and we will say if it fits.
How do I start?
A free 15-minute discovery call. We learn the project and recommend the package so you can start.
